body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). Four test files in packages/core/test manually invoke mkdtempSync and guard removals in try/finally blocks, and are allowlisted in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs. With @adlc/core/test-kit (tmp, gitRepo), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via t.after when passed the test context t.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In packages/core/test/prosecutor-record-finding.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '../lib/test-kit.mjs'.
   - Update test declarations to accept the t parameter from test(...).
   - Replace mkDir() calls with tmp(t, 'adlc-record-finding-').
   - Remove manual try { ... } finally { rmSync(dir, ...); } blocks, unindenting the test bodies.
   - Delete the local const mkDir = ... helper.
2. In packages/core/test/railpath.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '../lib/test-kit.mjs'.
   - Update test declarations to accept t parameter.
   - Update makeRepo(t) to allocate root using realpathSync(tmp(t, 'railpath-')).
   - Remove manual try { ... } finally { rmSync(root, ...); } blocks, unindenting test bodies.
3. In packages/core/test/revision-change-set.test.mjs:
   - Import { gitRepo } from '../lib/test-kit.mjs'.
   - Update test declarations to accept t parameter.
   - Update repo(t) to delegate to gitRepo(t, { prefix: 'adlc-changeset-' }).
   - Remove manual try { ... } finally { clean(d); } blocks, unindenting test bodies.
   - Delete the local const clean = ... helper.
4. In packages/core/test/scaffold-hygiene.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '../lib/test-kit.mjs'.
   - Update test declarations to accept t parameter.
   - Update mkRoot(t) to use tmp(t, 'adlc-core-scaffold-hygiene-').
   - Remove manual try { ... } finally { rmSync(root, ...); } blocks, unindenting test bodies.
5. In scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs:
   - Remove packages/core/test/prosecutor-record-finding.test.mjs, packages/core/test/railpath.test.mjs, packages/core/test/revision-change-set.test.mjs, and packages/core/test/scaffold-hygiene.test.mjs from the ALLOWLIST set (completely eradicates packages/core from the allowlist!).
6. Verification:
   - npm test -w packages/core exits 0 with all test cases passing.
   - node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
   - grep -E 'packages/core/test/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs returns nothing.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 packages/core/test/prosecutor-record-finding.test.mjs does not define mkDir and contains 0 finally blocks.
- AC2 packages/core/test/railpath.test.mjs contains 0 finally blocks.
- AC3 packages/core/test/revision-change-set.test.mjs does not define clean and contains 0 finally blocks.
- AC4 packages/core/test/scaffold-hygiene.test.mjs contains 0 finally blocks.
- AC5 grep -E 'packages/core/test/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs returns nothing.
- AC6 npm test -w packages/core exits 0 with all tests passing.
- AC7 node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC8 adlc rails-guard exits 0.
title: refactor(core): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate try/finally blocks in core boundary tests
